title: Having been told, not knowing, with … V-ing
summary: Mệnh đề phân từ nâng cao: having been + V3 (bị động trước), not + V-ing, with + danh từ + V-ing/V3, và phân từ sau liên từ (when asked, once finished).

dialogue.en: [[Having been told]] it was informal, I wore jeans.
dialogue.vi: Được bảo là không trang trọng nên mình mặc quần jeans.

dialogue.en: No! [[Not knowing]] what to do, I just smiled.
dialogue.vi: Không! Không biết làm gì, mình chỉ cười.

dialogue.en: [[When asked]] about your experience, what did you say?
dialogue.vi: Khi được hỏi về kinh nghiệm, bạn nói gì?

dialogue.en: I talked for ten minutes, [[with everyone staring]] at my jeans!
dialogue.vi: Mình nói mười phút, trong khi ai cũng nhìn chằm chằm vào quần mình!

sections.heading: Having been + V3
sections.rule: **Having been + V3** = **đã được / bị** làm gì **trước** việc chính (bị động + hoàn thành).

examples.vi: Đã được cảnh báo nên chúng tôi mang ô.

examples.en: [[Having been rejected]] twice, she gave up.
examples.vi: Bị từ chối hai lần, cô ấy bỏ cuộc.

check.prompt: ___ the job, he moved to Hanoi.
check.explain: Được mời trước (bị động) → having been offered.

sections.heading: Not + V-ing, not having + V3
sections.rule: Phủ định mệnh đề phân từ: đặt **not** lên **trước** phân từ: **Not knowing…, Not having seen…**

examples.en: [[Not knowing]] the way, we asked a local.
examples.vi: Không biết đường, chúng tôi hỏi người địa phương.

examples.en: [[Not having eaten]] all day, he was starving.
examples.vi: Cả ngày chưa ăn gì, anh ấy đói lả.

check.prompt: ___ what to say, she stayed silent.

sections.heading: With + danh từ + V-ing / V3, when asked, once finished
sections.rule: **with + danh từ + V-ing / V3** nêu hoàn cảnh đi kèm. Có thể giữ **liên từ + phân từ**: **when asked, once finished, if heated, while waiting**.

examples.en: She sat there [[with her eyes closed]].
examples.vi: Cô ấy ngồi đó, mắt nhắm lại.

examples.en: [[With prices rising]], many people save more.
examples.vi: Khi giá cả tăng, nhiều người tiết kiệm hơn.
Xong rồi thì gửi cho tôi.

check.prompt: With the deadline ___, we worked all night.

mistakes.wrong: Having rejected twice, she stopped applying.
mistakes.right: Having been rejected twice, she stopped applying.
mistakes.why: Bị từ chối (bị động) → having been rejected.

mistakes.wrong: Knowing not the answer, I guessed.
mistakes.right: Not knowing the answer, I guessed.

mistakes.wrong: With her eyes closing tightly, she prayed.
mistakes.right: With her eyes closed tightly, she prayed.

mistakes.wrong: When asking about it, he refused to answer.
mistakes.right: When asked about it, he refused to answer.

mistakes.wrong: Not having eat, I felt weak.
mistakes.right: Not having eaten, I felt weak.

exercises.prompt: ___ by the noise, she couldn't sleep.
___ twice before, I didn't want to go again.
exercises.explain: Bị cướp trước → having been robbed.

exercises.prompt: He walked in with his hands ___ in his pockets.

options: When questioned, the man said nothing.
When questioning, the man said nothing.

exercises.prompt: Not ___ slept well, I was tired.
With costs ___, the company cut jobs.
Once ___, the cake should be kept cold.

exercises.vi: Không biết làm gì, tôi gọi cho mẹ.
Cô ấy ngồi đó với đôi mắt nhắm lại.

exercises.sentence: Having invited to the wedding, we bought a gift.
answers: Having been invited to the wedding, we bought a gift.

exercises.sentence: Knowing not what to say, he left.
answers: Not knowing what to say, he left.

exercises.sentence: When asking, she said she was fine.
answers: When asked, she said she was fine.

exercises.vi: Được cảnh báo về cơn bão, họ ở nhà.
answers: Having been warned about the storm, they stayed at home.
Having been warned about the storm, they stayed home.
Warned about the storm, they stayed at home.
Warned about the storm, they stayed home.
Having been warned of the storm, they stayed at home.

exercises.vi: Với giá xăng tăng, nhiều người đi xe buýt.
answers: With petrol prices rising, many people take the bus.
With gas prices rising, many people take the bus.
With fuel prices rising, many people take the bus.
With gas prices going up, many people take the bus.
With petrol prices rising, many people are taking the bus.
With gas prices rising, many people are taking the bus.
